fatal_blockers: The current map labels 2-foot and 3-foot cover categories, but the recovered public records do not publish absolute final measured thickness values tied to the 2-foot polygons.
The 92-monument annual monitoring network reports soil-thickness loss and covers the RCRA-equivalent and 3-foot areas; it does not provide an absolute measured-depth grid for the 2-foot areas.
The recovered public records do not state numerical horizontal or vertical survey uncertainty.

The public record supports common vegetation assessment but does not prove that the final radar-facing soil source, gradation, compaction and moisture behavior are equivalent between the 2-foot and 3-foot polygons.
The named long-term care plan and final construction/as-built records were not recovered from the current Army reports page, the EPA live document table or the archived public-site search.
next_action: Continue the approved search unchanged. Advance only a full-scale vegetated pair whose public construction package provides coordinate-tied absolute final measured depths, numerical uncertainty and matching upper-soil construction.
